Subject: Request: Separate invoices per legal entity & cost center codes

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement pulled together the payment/legal requirements and we have a strict need to receive three separate invoices for this contract — one per legal entity — because each BU will cost-charge to different cost centers. Our requirements: 

- Three PDF invoices, each issued by the contracting Redwood legal entity (US / EU / APAC).
- Each invoice must list the associated Solstice cost-center code (format CC-XXXX) and a PO number.
- We need gross and net amounts broken out and VAT treatment clearly stated (we apply reverse-charge where applicable).
- PDF invoices must be separately signed (simple signature line is OK) and emailed to procurement and our AP team.

Attached is a one-page spec from our side (attached: VAT-residency-cert will follow once requested). Can you confirm we can do this and provide an ETA? Also include any special instructions for bank remittance or intermediary payments (we sometimes use third-party payment providers).

Best,
Aditi Shah
Head of Procurement
Solstice Health

Subject: Re: Request: Separate invoices per legal entity & cost center codes

Hi all — VAT checklist and requirements for reverse-charge on the EU invoice:

- We need Solstice's EU VAT registration number (format: IE1234567F or similar) and a confirmation that they are a taxable person for intra-EU transactions.
- Preferably a scanned VAT certificate (they mentioned they would provide). If they cannot provide, we must treat the invoice as domestic and charge applicable VAT.
- Invoices should include our EU VAT registration number and the wording: "VAT reverse charge applied — customer liable for local VAT" plus the customer's VAT number.

Operational note: if the payment comes via GlobalPay (Marco Leone), ensure the AP team maps the remittance to the correct legal entity bank account. Vivek — please confirm payment routing rules for GlobalPay payouts.

If Solstice confirms VAT number and PO numbers by EOD Friday (Dec 4), Marissa and I will finalize and we can issue the three signed PDFs by Dec 8.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Tax Counsel, Redwood Inference
